title: Parkinson's Research: The Organized Genetics Initiative
brief_summary: The purpose of this trial is to study genetic and other risk factors that may be important in the development of Parkinson's disease.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* To be eligible to participate in this study participants must be diagnosed with or have symptoms of PD. In addition, they must also have a family history of PD in other relatives.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Subjects cannot have participated in any other genetic research project for Parkinson's disease.
study_population: families having 2 or more members diagnosed with PD
